archetypes.name: contract-streams
archetypes.rationale: Diff changes stdout/stderr KV contracts for degraded-tools gate and downstream parsers must remain tolerant.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate whether degraded-tools-gate.sh preserves valid-input stdout compatibility while adding the empty-presence signal only in the intended bug cases. Check that callers and docs describe and consume PRESENCE_INPUT_EMPTY without breaking existing DEGRADED, BOTH_DOWN, and explanation marker parsing. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: bash32
archetypes.rationale: Changes add and modify several Bash scripts where Bash 3.2 portability, traps, arrays, and set -e behavior matter.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the shell changes for Bash 3.2 portability, safe quoting, trap cleanup, set -e interactions, and non-fatal failure handling. Pay special attention to the new compute-pr-line-counts.sh script and the array forwarding in write-final-report.sh. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: gh-api
archetypes.rationale: A new gh api integration computes PR line counts and feeds final summaries, creating permission and pagination risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine the new PR line-count path from compute-pr-line-counts.sh through write-final-report.sh and render-run-summary.sh. Check behavior for missing PR numbers, forked repos, unavailable gh auth, pagination, API field assumptions, and repository resolution. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: skill-fences
archetypes.rationale: The plan relies on executable SKILL.md fences staying mechanically aligned with structural tests and durable session env semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the design and implement SKILL.md gate fences as runtime instructions, not just documentation. Verify that the durable-env rehydration flow, plugin-root recovery, sentinel behavior, and structural test pins stay aligned with the actual scripts they reference. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
